coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z; quadrupedal slight sprawl.

concept.reason: Actual museum skeletal image inspected plus museum anatomical descriptions; no extra concept required.

scope: Original whole organism: small head, barrel trunk, crossbar-bearing dorsal sail. Not skeletal replica or renamed Dimetrodon.
specimen_basis: AMNH FR7003 confirms named genus reference; visual anatomy uses Museum of Evolution published E.boanerges skeletal display photograph. Display image has no catalogue number and is NOT asserted to be FR7003.

scale.basis: Artistic target within museum-published genus range approximately0.5–3.5m; not measured AMNH7003 or displayed specimen length.

diagnostic_targets: Tiny blunt head on short neck, deep rounded barrel torso, four stocky laterally placed limbs, long tapering tail.
Tall dorsal sail supported by long graded spines with short lateral crossbar-like knobs; preserve transverse relief, not smooth generic Dimetrodon fin.
Live skin-covered sail rather than exposed skeletal telephone poles; show subdued rounded transverse bosses, not branched antlers.
Closed herbivorous mouth, no saber canines, no dinosaur upright pelvis or bipedal pose.
uncertainties: Exact soft-tissue thickness over crossbars and membrane outline are unknown; boss relief is conservative stylization, not claimed exposed bone.
Whole-body surface, posture and colour inferred from skeleton; no claim fossil colour.
Exact specimen scale unverified; genus-size artistic target declared. Display contains restored bones, not all anatomy claimed original fossil.
acceptance_checks: Distinct from existing Dimetrodon through much smaller head, broader barrel trunk and crossbar-bearing sail relief.
Front/top shows lateral boss relief along several sail spines; side silhouette remains tall continuous sail without freestanding antlers.
All four feet integrated, five simplified digit tips each where visible; belly clear of ground in mild sprawl.
Default four views, perspective can reuse preview. Original procedural geometry, no traced photograph textures or downloaded mesh.
handoff_contract: Same directory prep/maker/QA. Maker reports COMPLETE fixed hashes then stops, no upload/cleanup. Root asynchronous private backup; retain local for later integration and batch release.
